findings.explanation: Both INV-1005 and REC-1005 reference PO-1005, but no purchase order document exists anywhere in this transaction's evidence, leaving the procurement authorization unsupported.
REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice it references (INV-1005, dated 2026-07-21), which is unusual sequencing though plausible for goods received prior to billing.
